title: Research Interests
reading: An overview slide listing three research directions: multimodal generative AI infused with domain-specific knowledge (human, environment, biology), learning with imperfect data and supervision (noisy, imbalanced, long-tailed data), and 2D/3D/4D perception and reconstruction for robotics and AR/VR. A strip of four project figures runs across the bottom, each illustrating one of these threads.

visuals.description: Long-tailed class frequency plot (log scale) flanked by example images for classes such as tennis racket, teacup, bird feeder.
visuals.assertion: Real-world recognition datasets follow a long-tailed class distribution, motivating learning with imbalanced data.

visuals.description: A street photo with a yellow arrow labelled 'OVO' pointing to a voxelized 3D semantic scene with magenta road and blue/grey structures.
visuals.assertion: A single image can be lifted into a semantically labelled 3D voxel occupancy reconstruction.

visuals.description: A colored skeleton pose plus the prompt 'photo of a famous woman' next to a grid of six generated portraits of women of varied ethnicity in ornate dress.
visuals.assertion: Pose-conditioned generative models can produce diverse controlled human images from a prompt.

visuals.description: Multi-view photos of a standing person on planes, an arrow to a grey 3D body mesh with rainbow inner-to-outer color scale legend.
visuals.assertion: Multi-view images can be reconstructed into a 3D human body model with inner/outer surface depth encoding.
